name: Splintertree Post
summary: Splintertree Post holds the Horde’s eastern Ashenvale frontier, northwest of Felfire Hill. Grommash Hellscream and the Warsong clan established it during the Third War as a fortified base against the night elves and a staging ground for expansion.

sections.title: A Frontier Stronghold
sections.body: Splintertree Post anchors the Horde’s military and supply lines across eastern Ashenvale. Grommash Hellscream and the Warsong clan founded it when the orcs first entered the forest during the Third War. Orcish and tauren scouts and warriors still defend the armed outpost. An inn, a flight master, and steady supplies from Orgrimmar support the Horde’s contested hold beneath the trees.

sections.title: The Constant Threat of Retaliation
sections.body: Splintertree Post remains ready for attack. The night elves have neither forgotten nor forgiven Grommash’s actions during the war. They also oppose the Horde’s continued logging and raids on Astranaar. Sentinels hide in the surrounding woods and launch constant retaliatory guerrilla strikes, testing the post’s watchmen at all hours.

faq.answer: Grommash Hellscream and the Warsong clan established Splintertree Post when the orcs first pushed into Ashenvale during the Third War to gather timber and secure a foothold.

faq.q: Why do the night elves frequently attack this base?
faq.answer: The night elves regard Splintertree Post as an illegal, desecrating intrusion on their ancestral lands. Their hostility also stems from Grommash’s brutal campaigns during the Third War, continued Horde logging, and skirmishes against Astranaar.

faq.q: What amenities and travel options are available here?
faq.answer: Splintertree Post has an inn, stable master, mailbox, armor repair, and a wind rider flight master. Its routes connect to Orgrimmar, the Crossroads, and other Horde outposts across Kalimdor.

faq.q: Who currently makes up the garrison at Splintertree?
faq.answer: Orcs and tauren make up most of Splintertree Post’s garrison. They serve as seasoned scouts, sentries, and frontline officers charged with holding the frontier.

angles.text: For Horde adventurers pressing through Ashenvale, Splintertree Post offers repairs, rest, and vital flight routes across Kalimdor.
To night elves, Splintertree Post scars Ashenvale. Grommash, the warlord who struck down Cenarius, founded it, and its people continue to butcher their ancient trees.
